items.title: 綠基雲端AI與港口智慧視覺應用雙引擎 帶動業務衝新高
items.title_en: GreenBase Cloud AI and Port Smart Vision Applications Dual Engines Drive Business to New Highs
paras: 工業電腦廠新漢(8234-TW)旗下綠基(7771-TW)持續拓展AI應用，其中，除了受惠美系雲端AI客戶需求成長，帶動相關業績攀升；子公司安恩嘉則在港口AI智慧視覺領域取得海外訂單，與荷蘭智慧碼頭系統業者Certus Automation合作，深化港口AI智慧視覺應用布局。
綠基9月營收1.22億元，創單月歷史新高，月增19%、年增132%；累計前9月營收7.22億元，年增44%，不僅創歷史同期新高，更超越去年一整年。
安恩嘉在經濟部產業發展署經費支持下，針對港口強風、豪雨等作業環境，開發應用於貨櫃辨識及碼頭自動化的AI智慧視覺技術，結合「AI ShakeDry」AI雨滴偵測與微震除水技術，以及OIS光學防手震技術，降低雨滴遮蔽及強風晃動造成的影像干擾，提升貨櫃編號辨識的穩定度。
安恩嘉AI智慧視覺技術於2025年在高雄港第七貨櫃中心完成商業驗證（PoB），並於2026年6月在歐洲港口試用後取得正式訂單，預計2027年1月全面導入，安恩嘉於也國際電子展期間，與荷蘭Certus Automation確立台荷港口AI智慧視覺應用合作案，雙方將深化貨櫃辨識及碼頭自動化領域合作，持續拓展海外市場。
綠基表示，隨著後續應用逐步擴大，將國內場域驗證成果進一步轉化為海外商業實績，未來將整合集團研發、產品商品化及場域導入能力，深化國際合作，推動長期業務成長。
paras_en: Industrial computer maker Xinhan (8234‑TW) and its subsidiary GreenBase (7771‑TW) continue expanding AI applications. In addition to benefiting from growing demand from U.S. cloud AI customers, which lifts related revenue, its subsidiary Anenja has secured overseas orders in the port AI smart‑vision field, partnering with Dutch smart‑port system provider Certus Automation to deepen its port AI smart‑vision deployment.

GreenBase posted September revenue of NT$122 million, a record monthly high, up 19% month‑over‑month and 132% year‑over‑year. Cumulative revenue for the first nine months reached NT$722 million, a 44% annual increase, setting a new historical peak for the same period and surpassing the entire previous year’s total.

With funding from the Ministry of Economic Affairs’ Industrial Development Agency, Anenja developed AI smart‑vision technology for harsh port environments such as strong winds and heavy rain. The technology, used for container identification and terminal automation, integrates AI ShakeDry rain‑drop detection and micro‑vibration water‑removal, as well as OIS optical image‑stabilization, reducing image interference from rain and wind and improving the stability of container number recognition.

Anenja’s AI smart‑vision solution completed commercial verification (PoB) at Kaohsiung Port’s seventh container terminal in 2025, and after a trial at a European port in June 2026 secured a formal order. The solution is slated for full deployment in January 2027. During the International Electronics Exhibition, Anenja and Dutch Certus Automation confirmed a Taiwan‑Netherlands port AI smart‑vision cooperation, deepening collaboration on container identification and terminal automation and further expanding overseas markets.

GreenBase said that as applications continue to expand, it will convert domestic field‑validation results into overseas commercial achievements. Going forward, the group will integrate R&D, product commercialization, and field implementation capabilities, deepen international cooperation, and drive long‑term business growth.

items.title: 〈星宇直飛布拉格〉搶啖歐洲半導體聚落新商機 成AI趨勢另類受惠者
items.title_en: Starlux Direct Flights to Prague Seize New Business Opportunities in Europe’s Semiconductor Cluster, Emerging as an Alternative Beneficiary of the AI Trend
paras: 星宇航空(2646-TW)直飛捷克布拉格，開啟國人新一波東歐旅遊熱潮，星宇表示，更著眼於商務往來加速發展中，隨著台灣半導體產業的快速成長，正積極跟進國內AI供應鏈的腳步，也成為AI趨勢下的周邊產業受惠者。
在台灣半導體產業的快速發展之際，星宇跟進AI供應鏈布局新航點或是加密航班，例如：鳳凰城每周由4班增至5班、鄰近德國德勒斯登的東歐航點布拉格每周增至4班。
而對於正在迅速發展AI資料中心的馬來西亞吉隆坡，則是透過將機型從A321提升至A330，來因應日益龐大的商務往來需求。
星宇也提到，i-TRANS Global s.r.o.(台灣 i-TRANS Express 艾爾斯全球倉儲物流的歐洲實體)正式進駐捷克烏斯季州 (Ústí nad Labem Region)，這項合作是台捷半導體戰略結盟的重要里程碑，並帶來航空商務往來新商機。
i-TRANS Global s.r.o.將打造一座占地近1.7萬平方公尺的特殊化學品與氣體倉儲物流中心，主要服務對象是德國德勒斯登的 Silicon Saxony半導體聚落，包括台積電(2330-TW)的歐洲新廠。
由於半導體製造極度依賴高純度、高穩定度的化學材料供應鏈，i-TRANS Global 將把台灣領先全球的「晶片化學物流管理經驗」複製至中歐，同步推升台灣的商務往來需求熱度。
paras_en: Starlux Airlines (2646‑TW) now flies directly to Prague, Czech Republic, sparking a fresh wave of travel interest in Eastern Europe among Taiwanese. The carrier says it is also focusing on accelerating business travel as Taiwan’s semiconductor industry rapidly expands, and it is actively aligning with the domestic AI supply chain, becoming a beneficiary of the AI‑driven ecosystem.

Amid the fast‑pace growth of Taiwan’s semiconductor sector, Starlux is adding AI‑related routes and increasing flight frequencies, such as raising Phoenix to five weekly flights and expanding the Eastern‑European route to Prague, near Germany’s Dresden, to four flights per week.
For Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia—a city rapidly developing AI data centers—Starlux is upgrading its aircraft from the A321 to the larger A330 to meet the growing demand for business travel.

Starlux also noted that i‑TRANS Global s.r.o., the European arm of Taiwan’s i‑TRANS Express logistics firm, has officially entered the Ústí nad Labem region of the Czech Republic. The partnership marks a key milestone in the Taiwan‑Czech semiconductor strategic alliance and creates new opportunities for aviation‑related business.

i‑TRANS Global s.r.o. will build a specialized chemical and gas storage and logistics hub covering nearly 17,000 square metres, primarily serving the Silicon Saxony semiconductor cluster around Dresden, Germany, including TSMC’s (2330‑TW) new European fab.

Because semiconductor manufacturing heavily depends on ultra‑pure, highly stable chemical supplies, i‑TRANS Global will replicate Taiwan’s world‑leading chip‑chemical logistics expertise in Central Europe, simultaneously boosting demand for Taiwanese business interactions.

items.title: 中國MiniMax、DeepSeek算力遠遜卻能追頂尖AI 「蒸餾」仍難解釋這項落差
items.title_en: China's MiniMax and DeepSeek Lag Far Behind in Compute Yet Can Match Top AI; "Distillation" Still Fails to Explain the Gap
paras: 科技媒體《Wccftech》報導，MiniMax 與 DeepSeek 的算力規模，分別約相當於 7 萬顆及 4.7 萬顆輝達 H100 GPU，相較之下，OpenAI 約為 370 萬顆。不過，這些數字來自報導引用的社群估算，尚未獲得各家公司完整證實，統計口徑與可比性也有待釐清。
報導指出，MiniMax 最新模型在部分 AI 代理任務評測中，展現具競爭力的效能與成本表現；DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 則在程式開發任務上維持優勢。兩家公司各有所長，尚不能以單一測試結果判定全面領先。
DeepSeek 官方資料顯示，17 日推出的更新版本，在維持 API 價格不變的情況下，提高多項基準測試成績，並縮短任務執行時間及輸出長度。其中，DeepSWE v1.1 成績由前一版本的 74.2 升至 77.0，主打以更低成本、更快速度完成任務。
MiniMax 則將重點放在降低 AI 代理的實際使用門檻。
根據《Wccftech》整理，M3.1 Flash 採用混合專家架構 (MoE)，總參數量為 4,280 億，每次運算啟用約 230 億參數；每百萬輸入 token 收費 0.15 美元，輸出則為 0.60 美元。
為降低長文本處理負擔，模型採用 MiniMax 稀疏注意力機制 (MSA)，先篩選與當前任務較相關的資料區塊，再集中運算資源處理，減少逐一檢視完整上下文的需求。
報導指出，在特定長上下文條件下，這項設計可將注意力運算需求降至標準方法約 1/20，並加快輸入處理及文字生成。
不過，這項數據針對特定注意力運算環節，不能直接視為整個模型的總算力需求減少 95%。
除模型架構外，MiniMax 也透過 GPU 運算核心、記憶體配置與推測解碼等工程調整，提高硬體使用效率。
MiniMax 宣稱，新模型的線上推論速度接近原先的 3 倍，AI 代理任務成本降低 70%，並強化程式設計、電腦操作與資安能力。
這些進展也讓「模型蒸餾」再度成為討論焦點。
蒸餾是利用較強模型產生的答案或推理資料，訓練另一個模型，以較低成本學習特定能力；但是否涉及未經授權使用競爭對手輸出，仍須依資料來源與使用方式判斷。
分析指出，中國業者的算力限制，使其更有動機透過蒸餾取得訓練資料。不過，這仍屬報導分析，不能僅憑算力規模較小，就認定特定模型必然依賴美國業者的技術。
此報導另以 DeepSeek 新模型較少出現幻覺，質疑蒸餾是否足以解釋其進步。然而，幻覺率高低本身不足以證明或排除蒸餾，仍須進一步檢視訓練資料、方法與評測條件。
MiniMax 與 DeepSeek 的最新動向，凸顯 AI 競爭正同時圍繞模型能力、運算效率與使用成本展開。
中國業者能否持續縮小與美國龍頭的差距，仍有待更多獨立評測與實際應用驗證。
paras_en: Technology outlet Wccftech reported that MiniMax and DeepSeek’s compute scales are roughly equivalent to 70,000 and 47,000 Nvidia H100 GPUs respectively, while OpenAI’s is about 3.7 million. These figures come from community estimates cited in the report and have not been fully confirmed by the companies; the methodology and comparability remain unclear.

The report notes that MiniMax’s latest model shows competitive performance and cost efficiency on certain AI‑agent benchmark tasks, while DeepSeek‑V4.1‑Flash‑1017 retains an edge on programming tasks. Each company has its strengths, and a single test cannot determine overall superiority.

DeepSeek’s official data shows that the version released on the 17th improved several benchmark scores while keeping API pricing unchanged, shortening task execution time and output length. Specifically, DeepSWE v1.1 rose from 74.2 to 77.0, emphasizing lower‑cost, faster task completion.
MiniMax, on the other hand, focuses on lowering the practical entry barrier for AI agents.

According to Wccftech’s summary, the M3.1 Flash uses a mixture‑of‑experts (MoE) architecture with 428 billion parameters, activating about 23 billion per inference; pricing is $0.15 per million input tokens and $0.60 per million output tokens.

To reduce the burden of long‑text processing, the model employs MiniMax Sparse Attention (MSA), which first filters data blocks most relevant to the current task and then concentrates compute resources on them, avoiding the need to scan the entire context sequentially.

The report states that under specific long‑context conditions this design can cut attention‑compute demand to roughly one‑twentieth of standard methods, speeding up input handling and text generation.
However, this figure applies only to the attention‑compute stage and should not be taken as a 95% reduction in the model’s overall compute requirement.
Beyond architecture, MiniMax also improves hardware efficiency through GPU core, memory configuration, and inference decoding optimizations.

MiniMax claims the new model’s online inference speed is nearly three times faster than its predecessor, AI‑agent task costs are reduced by 70%, and capabilities in programming, computer operation, and cybersecurity are enhanced.
These advances have revived discussion around “model distillation.”

Distillation involves using answers or reasoning generated by a stronger model to train another model, allowing the latter to learn specific abilities at lower cost; whether this entails unauthorized use of competitors’ outputs depends on data sources and usage methods.

Analysts point out that Chinese firms’ compute constraints give them stronger incentive to use distillation for training data, but this remains speculative analysis—small compute alone does not prove a model must rely on U.S. technology.

The report also observes that DeepSeek’s new model exhibits fewer hallucinations, questioning whether distillation alone can explain its progress. Hallucination rates by themselves are insufficient to confirm or rule out distillation; further scrutiny of training data, methods, and evaluation conditions is needed.
MiniMax and DeepSeek’s latest moves highlight that AI competition is simultaneously revolving around model capability, computational efficiency, and usage cost.
Whether Chinese players can continue narrowing the gap with U.S. leaders will depend on more independent benchmarks and real‑world application validation.

items.title: 〈星宇直飛布拉格〉細談三大洲航網規劃方向 這些航點均有機會直航
items.title_en: Starlux Direct Flights to Prague: Discussing the Planning Direction of Its Network Across Three Continents, These Destinations All Have Potential for Direct Service
paras: 星宇航空即將於10月25日首航台中-名古屋，在陸續深化日本航線布局後，認為近程航網大致完成，除了關注季節性的旅遊需求來放大機型因應，後續擴展航網主軸將著重在美洲、歐洲，同時大洋洲首個航點「快要有結果了」，包括雪梨、墨爾本、布里斯本等地都有機會。
星宇規劃，未來主要新航點將放在美國東部、中部和南部等，例如紐約、芝加哥、華盛頓等均在評估中，原因在於東南亞航線到美洲的旅客量能很大，善用台灣的轉機地理位置優勢。
同時，星宇也期待加強拓展歐洲，包括瑞士的蘇黎世、西班牙的巴塞隆納、芬蘭的赫爾辛基等，並發展在歐洲的合作夥伴，期待最快明年可看到歐洲新航點，但確定時程有待航權談判。
由於美洲沒有航權限制，擴張速度將較快。
星宇進一步提到，大洋洲擴點「快要有結果了」，包括雪梨、墨爾本、布里斯本等地都有機會。
星宇規劃，拓點會搭配交機時間，同步持續加大航班服務頻率，目前總機隊為38架，預估到年底可達42架，增加的4架新機分別為1架350-1000 、1架330-900 和2架321 Neo，明年再交機6架機隊，總數達48架。
paras_en: Starlux Airlines will launch its inaugural Taichung‑Nagoya flight on October 25. After progressively deepening its Japan route network, the airline believes its short‑haul network is largely complete. Apart from focusing on seasonal travel demand to upscale aircraft deployment, future network expansion will concentrate on the Americas and Europe, while the first Oceania destinations are "almost finalized," with Sydney, Melbourne and Brisbane also in contention.

Starlux plans to add new destinations mainly in the eastern, central and southern United States—cities such as New York, Chicago and Washington are under evaluation. The rationale is the large volume of passengers traveling from Southeast Asia to the Americas, allowing the airline to leverage Taiwan’s geographic advantage as a transfer hub.

The carrier also aims to strengthen its European footprint, targeting cities like Zurich in Switzerland, Barcelona in Spain and Helsinki in Finland, and to develop partnerships with European airlines. It hopes to see new European routes as early as next year, although exact timing depends on traffic‑rights negotiations.
Because there are no traffic‑rights restrictions for the Americas, expansion there is expected to proceed more quickly.
Starlux added that its Oceania expansion is "almost finalized," with Sydney, Melbourne and Brisbane all being possible new destinations.

Starlux’s expansion will be coordinated with aircraft deliveries and increased flight frequencies. The fleet currently stands at 38 aircraft and is projected to reach 42 by year‑end, adding one A350‑1000, one A330‑900 and two A321 Neo. An additional six aircraft are slated for delivery next year, bringing the total fleet to 48 planes.

items.title: 〈星宇直飛布拉格〉樂看Q4、明年上半年成長均達4成 惟憂心油價變數
items.title_en: StarLux Direct Flights to Prague: Optimistic About 40% Growth in Q4 and First Half of Next Year, but Worried About Oil Price Variable
paras: 進入第四季航空相對淡季，不過，星宇航空(2646-TW)公關長簡文龍明確指出，進入第四季後狀況還是不錯，訂位維持相對高，貨運也處在運輸旺季，「有望成長4成跑不掉」，而目前看明年訂位狀況，上半年還是有成長4成，惟油價是最大的不可控變數。
星宇說明，第四季東北亞線訂位狀況還是很好，滑雪旺季的旅遊需求熱絡，國人喜愛東京周邊越後湯澤、名古屋周邊飛馱高山和九州等地，而歐洲線因有耶誕節慶，表現也不差，整體航空基本面不錯。
不過，星宇直指主要面臨變數還是油價，且難以避開，「因應之道有限」。
星宇進一步說明，去年航空燃油平均每桶在80美元左右，4月以後最高達160-170 美元，導致用油成本從過往平均占總成本比重2成至目前來到約3成。
星宇今年前三季合併營收448.35億元，年增37%，10月起陸續開闢台北-峇里島、台中-札幌、台中-名古屋新航線，正持續擴大航網並深化旅遊市場布局，而隨著新機陸續交付，於冬季班表規劃多條熱門航線增班並放大機型。
其中，台北-函館和台北-清邁航線將安排增班並改以A330neo廣體客機執飛，顯示東北亞和東南亞的旅運需求持續居高。
paras_en: Entering the fourth quarter, which is relatively off‑peak for airlines, however, StarLux Airlines (2646‑TW) Chief Public Relations Officer Jian Wen‑long clearly stated that the situation after entering Q4 is still good, bookings remain relatively high, cargo is also in a peak season, "we expect a 40% growth that cannot be missed", and looking at next year's bookings, the first half also shows a 40% increase, but oil price is the biggest uncontrollable variable.

StarLux explained that the booking situation on Northeast Asia routes in Q4 remains very good; the ski season drives strong travel demand, with Taiwanese travelers favoring destinations such as Echigo‑Yuzawa near Tokyo, high‑altitude areas around Nagoya, and Kyushu, while European routes also performed well due to Christmas festivities, indicating an overall solid airline fundamentals.
However, StarLux pointed directly that the main variable remains oil price, and it is difficult to avoid, "the ways to cope are limited".

StarLux further noted that last year the average price of aviation fuel was around US$80 per barrel, and after April it peaked at US$160‑170, causing fuel costs to rise from about 20% of total costs historically to roughly 30% now.

StarLux’s combined revenue for the first three quarters of this year was NT$44.835 billion, up 37% year‑on‑year. Starting in October, the airline gradually opened new routes such as Taipei‑Bali, Taichung‑Sapporo, and Taichung‑Nagoya, continuously expanding its network and deepening its tourism market layout. With new aircraft being delivered, the winter schedule will add multiple popular routes and upscale aircraft types.

Among them, the Taipei‑Hakodate and Taipei‑Chiang Mai routes will add frequencies and will be operated with A330neo wide‑body jets, showing that travel demand in Northeast Asia and Southeast Asia remains high.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉磷化銦需求爆發 光環漲逾半根站上所有均線
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Indium Phosphide Demand Booms, Guanghuan Rises Over Half, Above All Moving Averages
paras: 三五族光通訊廠受惠於全球AI資料中心軍備競賽，正從GPU、先進封裝一路燒向光通訊，光環(3234-TW)今(20)日開盤震盪，盤中在大單敲進下，量增價揚大漲7.5%，衝上193元，成交超過4,000張，較昨(19)日增近2倍。
光環因AI伺服器的算力愈來愈強，加上資料中心從800G向1.6T甚至3.2T演進，過去傳統銅線與電訊號逐漸遭遇傳輸距離、頻寬及功耗瓶頸。
光環以磷化銦(InP)磊晶為主的光通訊廠產品，也成為下一階段中，AI基礎建設的重要發展方向，包括光環間接打入Lumentum(LITE-US)、祥茂光電(AAOI-US)等美系光通訊大廠供應鏈。隨著 AI 資料中心傳輸規格由 800G 升級至 1.6T，對具備高發光效率、長距離傳輸特性的磷化銦 CW Laser(連續雷射)需求爆發，也帶動光環營收表現強勁增長
法人表示，以磷化銦(InP)磊晶為主的光通訊廠產品，也成為下一階段中，AI基礎建設的重要發展方向。
光環今(2026)年第3季營收 3.26 億元、季增66.3%，年增115.9%，成長動能來自於產品代工動能強勁，在毛利率上，考量到NRE收入與代工業務使稼動率持續提升，法人推估第3季毛利率有望提升至31.4%。
光環為因應客戶需求，也持續擴增磷化銦後段製程產能，法人估今(2026)年底產能有望較第3季翻倍成長，並同步採購設備已應付擴產。
據光環法說會上表示，光環企圖心也不只停留在現階段100mW產品，公司目前正積極打造300mW新產能，希望進一步切入CPO 供應鏈。法人表示，目前光還100mW CW Laser主要對應1.6T高速傳輸需求，當未來AI資料中心走向更高頻寬與CPO架構，高功率雷射的重要性將進一步提高。
paras_en: The optical communication factories of the 35mm family are benefiting from the global AI data‑center arms race, shifting from GPUs and advanced packaging to optical communications. Guanghuan (3234‑TW) opened today (20th) with a volatile start, but after a large order hit the market, volume surged and the price jumped 7.5% to NT$193, with more than 4,000 lots traded—almost double yesterday’s (19th) volume.

Because AI servers are becoming increasingly powerful and data centers are evolving from 800 Gbps to 1.6 Tbps and even 3.2 Tbps, traditional copper wiring and electrical signals are increasingly hitting limits in transmission distance, bandwidth, and power consumption.

Guanghuan’s optical‑communication products, which are based mainly on indium phosphide (InP) epitaxial wafers, have become a key development direction for the next stage of AI infrastructure. This includes indirect supply to major U.S. optical‑communication players such as Lumentum (LITE‑US) and AAOI (AAOI‑US). As AI data‑center transmission specs upgrade from 800 Gbps to 1.6 Tbps, demand for high‑efficiency, long‑distance InP continuous‑wave (CW) lasers is exploding, driving strong revenue growth for Guanghuan.
Institutions note that InP‑based optical‑communication products are becoming an important development direction for the next phase of AI infrastructure.

Guanghuan reported Q3 2026 revenue of NT$326 million, up 66.3% quarter‑over‑quarter and 115.9% year‑over‑year. The growth momentum comes from robust product foundry activity. Considering NRE income and foundry business that continuously raise utilization, analysts estimate the Q3 gross margin could rise to 31.4%.

To meet customer demand, Guanghuan is continuously expanding its downstream InP manufacturing capacity. Analysts estimate that by the end of 2026 the capacity could double compared with Q3, and the company is already procuring equipment to support the expansion.

At Guanghuan’s earnings briefing, the company said its ambition goes beyond the current 100 mW product line. It is actively building a new 300 mW production line to further enter the CPO supply chain. Analysts note that the current 100 mW InP CW lasers mainly serve the 1.6 Tbps high‑speed transmission market, and as AI data centers move toward higher bandwidth and CPO architectures, the importance of high‑power lasers will increase further.

items.title: 外資法人聯手大賣！KOSPI連彈二日後又跌近5%　資料中心新股Elice上市首日慘崩30%
items.title_en: Foreign Institutions Join Massive Sell‑off! KOSPI Slides Nearly 5% After Two‑Day Rally, Data‑Center New‑issue Elice Crashes 30% on Debut
paras: 在連續兩日反彈、一度看似觸底後，南韓綜合股指(KOSPI)今(20)日再度大跌，跌幅一度深達4.76%，盤中失守5500點大關。
受美債殖利率上升以及資料中心企業上市首日表現疲軟的影響，外資紛紛減持韓股，包括退休金在內的法人機構也加入賣出行列，對市場形成明顯拖累。
AI資料中心新創公司Elice Group今日掛牌首日股價暴跌逾30%，發行價為每股90500韓元。截至首爾時間今日中午12時08分，股價下跌29.7%至63700韓元。根據相關申報文件，Elice在IPO期間獲得的機構認購訂單量達到可供認購股份數量的388.84倍。
截至發稿，外資在韓證券市場淨賣出6367億韓元，法人機構也淨賣超4670億韓元，其中金融投資機構淨賣出2418億韓元，退休金淨賣出1590億韓元。散戶和其他法人分別淨買超8388億韓元和2616億韓元，試圖支撐指數，限制進一步下跌。
南韓券商Eugene分析師Huh Jae-Hwan說：「此次拋售呈現無差別特徵，幾乎所有股票都在下跌。市場顯得非常脆弱。就連昨日曾引領反彈的電池製造商，如今也出現了回落。」
首爾Kiwoom證券分析師Kim Hak-joon說：「市場擔心這類公司恐無法從投資人那獲得後續融資。」
paras_en: After two consecutive days of rebound that seemed to signal a bottom, South Korea's composite index (KOSPI) fell sharply again on the 20th, sinking as much as 4.76% and slipping below the 5,500‑point mark during trading.

Rising U.S. Treasury yields and weak first‑day performance of a data‑center company prompted foreign investors to cut their holdings of Korean stocks, with institutional investors—including pension funds—also joining the sell‑off, weighing on the market.

AI data‑center startup Elice Group saw its debut price plunge more than 30% on the first day of trading, with an issue price of 90,500 won per share. By 12:08 pm Seoul time, the share price had fallen 29.7% to 63,700 won. According to filing documents, institutional orders during the IPO amounted to 388.84 times the number of shares offered.

At the time of reporting, foreign investors had a net sell of 636.7 billion won in the Korean securities market, while institutional investors posted a net sell of 467.0 billion won, including a net sell of 241.8 billion won by financial investment firms and 159.0 billion won by pension funds. Retail investors and other institutions net bought 838.8 billion won and 261.6 billion won respectively, trying to support the index and curb further declines.

Eugene Securities analyst Huh Jae‑Hwan said, "The sell‑off this time is indiscriminate, with almost every stock falling. The market looks extremely fragile. Even the battery maker that led yesterday's rebound has now slipped back."
Kiwoom Securities analyst Kim Hak‑joon in Seoul said, "The market worries that companies like this may be unable to secure further financing from investors."

items.title: RBC估SpaceX每股480美元收購特斯拉 合併後估值達3.74兆美元
items.title_en: RBC Estimates SpaceX Acquiring Tesla at $480 per Share, Post‑Merger Valuation Reaches $3.74 Trillion
paras: 《Benzinga》報導，根據 RBC Capital Markets 分析，SpaceX(SPCX-US) 可能以每股480美元的價格收購特斯拉(TSLA-US)，合併後的新公司估值將達到3.74兆美元。
不過，特斯拉股東屆時將只持有合併後公司48%的股權，低於該銀行7月估算的54%，儘管假設中的收購價格並未改變。
RBC分析師Tom Narayan在7月建立的模型中，估算合併後公司的價值為3.31兆美元，特斯拉股東將持有54%的股權。
但隨著SpaceX估值上升，情況已經改變。RBC最新的研究報告將合併後公司的估值提高至3.74兆美元，其中SpaceX股東將持有52%的股權。
這意味著，SpaceX股東所持股份的隱含價值，比特斯拉股東多出約4,220億美元；而特斯拉股東所持股份的價值則維持在約1.8兆美元。
RBC估算的每股480美元收購價格，代表特斯拉股東可獲得約30%的溢價。
在這項假設的全股票交易中，股東將獲得SpaceX股票，而非現金；最終價值則取決於兩家公司的股價及任何協議的具體條款。
RBC認為，合併可能帶來潛在效益，包括結合特斯拉的機器人與製造業務，以及SpaceX的AI基礎設施，當中也包括雙方在Terafab半導體計畫上的布局。
不過，該銀行表示，目前並不知道有任何實際交易正在進行。
9月，當被問及特斯拉與SpaceX為何仍維持獨立時，馬斯克（Elon Musk）稱這是個「很好的問題」，並告訴聽眾，考慮到兩家公司日益密切的合作關係，可以「想像一下」他可能採取什麼行動。
特斯拉股東真的能受益嗎？
Future Fund管理合夥人Gary Black上週警告特斯拉投資人，任何以SpaceX股票支付的收購溢價，都可能「被套利交易者侵蝕」。
Black認為，投資人可能會採用特斯拉較低的估值倍數來評估合併後的公司；另一方面，試圖從合併交易中獲利的套利交易者，也可能在交易完成前侵蝕這項溢價。
巴克萊銀行（Barclays）分析師Dan Levy上週表示，合併公告可能在特斯拉12月3日股東大會之前發布。
Polymarket上的交易者預測，SpaceX與特斯拉在12月31日前正式宣布合併的機率為18%，到2027年底則升至64%。
該預測市場的交易量已超過140萬美元。
特斯拉股價上漲逾3%，來到367美元；SpaceX股價則上漲逾2%，來到150美元。
SpaceX將於10月20日（週二）公布財報，特斯拉則預計於10月21日（週三）公布財報。
paras_en: Benzinga reports that, according to RBC Capital Markets analysis, SpaceX (SPCX‑US) could acquire Tesla (TSLA‑US) at $480 per share, giving the combined company a valuation of $3.74 trillion.
However, Tesla shareholders would own only 48% of the merged entity, down from the bank’s July estimate of 54%, even though the assumed purchase price has not changed.
RBC analyst Tom Narayan’s July model estimated the merged company’s value at $3.31 trillion, with Tesla shareholders holding 54% of the equity.
But as SpaceX’s valuation has risen, the picture has shifted. RBC’s latest research lifts the post‑merger valuation to $3.74 trillion, with SpaceX shareholders owning 52% of the equity.

This implies that the implied value of the stake held by SpaceX shareholders exceeds that of Tesla shareholders by about $422 billion, while the value of the Tesla shareholders’ stake remains around $1.8 trillion.
RBC’s $480‑per‑share acquisition price represents roughly a 30% premium for Tesla shareholders.
In this hypothetical all‑stock deal, shareholders would receive SpaceX stock rather than cash; the ultimate value depends on the two companies’ share prices and any specific deal terms.

RBC believes the merger could deliver synergies, including combining Tesla’s robotics and manufacturing businesses with SpaceX’s AI infrastructure, and also incorporates both firms’ involvement in the Terafab semiconductor project.
The bank notes, however, that it is not aware of any actual transaction currently underway.

In September, when asked why Tesla and SpaceX remain separate, Elon Musk called it a “good question” and told the audience that, given the increasingly close cooperation between the two companies, one can “imagine” what actions he might take.
Will Tesla shareholders really benefit?
Future Fund managing partner Gary Black warned Tesla investors last week that any acquisition premium paid in SpaceX stock could be “eroded by arbitrage traders.”

Black thinks investors may apply Tesla’s lower valuation multiples to the combined company; meanwhile, arbitrageurs seeking profit from the merger could eat away at the premium before the deal closes.
Barclays analyst Dan Levy said last week that a merger announcement could come before Tesla’s shareholder meeting on December 3.
Traders on Polymarket predict an 18% chance that SpaceX and Tesla will formally announce a merger by December 31, rising to 64% by the end of 2027.
The prediction market’s trading volume has already exceeded $1.4 million.
Tesla’s share price rose more than 3% to $367, while SpaceX’s share price climbed over 2% to $150.
SpaceX will release its earnings on Tuesday, October 20, and Tesla is expected to report its earnings on Wednesday, October 21.

items.title: 綠基雲端AI與港口智慧視覺應用雙引擎 帶動業務衝新高
items.title_en: GreenBase Cloud AI and Port Smart Vision Applications Dual Engines Drive Business to New Highs
paras: 工業電腦廠新漢(8234-TW)旗下綠基(7771-TW)持續拓展AI應用，其中，除了受惠美系雲端AI客戶需求成長，帶動相關業績攀升；子公司安恩嘉則在港口AI智慧視覺領域取得海外訂單，與荷蘭智慧碼頭系統業者Certus Automation合作，深化港口AI智慧視覺應用布局。
綠基9月營收1.22億元，創單月歷史新高，月增19%、年增132%；累計前9月營收7.22億元，年增44%，不僅創歷史同期新高，更超越去年一整年。
安恩嘉在經濟部產業發展署經費支持下，針對港口強風、豪雨等作業環境，開發應用於貨櫃辨識及碼頭自動化的AI智慧視覺技術，結合「AI ShakeDry」AI雨滴偵測與微震除水技術，以及OIS光學防手震技術，降低雨滴遮蔽及強風晃動造成的影像干擾，提升貨櫃編號辨識的穩定度。
安恩嘉AI智慧視覺技術於2025年在高雄港第七貨櫃中心完成商業驗證（PoB），並於2026年6月在歐洲港口試用後取得正式訂單，預計2027年1月全面導入，安恩嘉於也國際電子展期間，與荷蘭Certus Automation確立台荷港口AI智慧視覺應用合作案，雙方將深化貨櫃辨識及碼頭自動化領域合作，持續拓展海外市場。
綠基表示，隨著後續應用逐步擴大，將國內場域驗證成果進一步轉化為海外商業實績，未來將整合集團研發、產品商品化及場域導入能力，深化國際合作，推動長期業務成長。
paras_en: Industrial computer maker Xinhan (8234‑TW) and its subsidiary GreenBase (7771‑TW) continue expanding AI applications. In addition to benefiting from growing demand from U.S. cloud AI customers, which lifts related revenue, its subsidiary Anenja has secured overseas orders in the port AI smart‑vision field, partnering with Dutch smart‑port system provider Certus Automation to deepen its port AI smart‑vision deployment.

GreenBase posted September revenue of NT$122 million, a record monthly high, up 19% month‑over‑month and 132% year‑over‑year. Cumulative revenue for the first nine months reached NT$722 million, a 44% annual increase, setting a new historical peak for the same period and surpassing the entire previous year’s total.

With funding from the Ministry of Economic Affairs’ Industrial Development Agency, Anenja developed AI smart‑vision technology for harsh port environments such as strong winds and heavy rain. The technology, used for container identification and terminal automation, integrates AI ShakeDry rain‑drop detection and micro‑vibration water‑removal, as well as OIS optical image‑stabilization, reducing image interference from rain and wind and improving the stability of container number recognition.

Anenja’s AI smart‑vision solution completed commercial verification (PoB) at Kaohsiung Port’s seventh container terminal in 2025, and after a trial at a European port in June 2026 secured a formal order. The solution is slated for full deployment in January 2027. During the International Electronics Exhibition, Anenja and Dutch Certus Automation confirmed a Taiwan‑Netherlands port AI smart‑vision cooperation, deepening collaboration on container identification and terminal automation and further expanding overseas markets.

GreenBase said that as applications continue to expand, it will convert domestic field‑validation results into overseas commercial achievements. Going forward, the group will integrate R&D, product commercialization, and field implementation capabilities, deepen international cooperation, and drive long‑term business growth.

items.title: 〈星宇直飛布拉格〉搶啖歐洲半導體聚落新商機 成AI趨勢另類受惠者
items.title_en: Starlux Direct Flights to Prague Seize New Business Opportunities in Europe’s Semiconductor Cluster, Emerging as an Alternative Beneficiary of the AI Trend
paras: 星宇航空(2646-TW)直飛捷克布拉格，開啟國人新一波東歐旅遊熱潮，星宇表示，更著眼於商務往來加速發展中，隨著台灣半導體產業的快速成長，正積極跟進國內AI供應鏈的腳步，也成為AI趨勢下的周邊產業受惠者。
在台灣半導體產業的快速發展之際，星宇跟進AI供應鏈布局新航點或是加密航班，例如：鳳凰城每周由4班增至5班、鄰近德國德勒斯登的東歐航點布拉格每周增至4班。
而對於正在迅速發展AI資料中心的馬來西亞吉隆坡，則是透過將機型從A321提升至A330，來因應日益龐大的商務往來需求。
星宇也提到，i-TRANS Global s.r.o.(台灣 i-TRANS Express 艾爾斯全球倉儲物流的歐洲實體)正式進駐捷克烏斯季州 (Ústí nad Labem Region)，這項合作是台捷半導體戰略結盟的重要里程碑，並帶來航空商務往來新商機。
i-TRANS Global s.r.o.將打造一座占地近1.7萬平方公尺的特殊化學品與氣體倉儲物流中心，主要服務對象是德國德勒斯登的 Silicon Saxony半導體聚落，包括台積電(2330-TW)的歐洲新廠。
由於半導體製造極度依賴高純度、高穩定度的化學材料供應鏈，i-TRANS Global 將把台灣領先全球的「晶片化學物流管理經驗」複製至中歐，同步推升台灣的商務往來需求熱度。
paras_en: Starlux Airlines (2646‑TW) now flies directly to Prague, Czech Republic, sparking a fresh wave of travel interest in Eastern Europe among Taiwanese. The carrier says it is also focusing on accelerating business travel as Taiwan’s semiconductor industry rapidly expands, and it is actively aligning with the domestic AI supply chain, becoming a beneficiary of the AI‑driven ecosystem.

Amid the fast‑pace growth of Taiwan’s semiconductor sector, Starlux is adding AI‑related routes and increasing flight frequencies, such as raising Phoenix to five weekly flights and expanding the Eastern‑European route to Prague, near Germany’s Dresden, to four flights per week.
For Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia—a city rapidly developing AI data centers—Starlux is upgrading its aircraft from the A321 to the larger A330 to meet the growing demand for business travel.

Starlux also noted that i‑TRANS Global s.r.o., the European arm of Taiwan’s i‑TRANS Express logistics firm, has officially entered the Ústí nad Labem region of the Czech Republic. The partnership marks a key milestone in the Taiwan‑Czech semiconductor strategic alliance and creates new opportunities for aviation‑related business.

i‑TRANS Global s.r.o. will build a specialized chemical and gas storage and logistics hub covering nearly 17,000 square metres, primarily serving the Silicon Saxony semiconductor cluster around Dresden, Germany, including TSMC’s (2330‑TW) new European fab.

Because semiconductor manufacturing heavily depends on ultra‑pure, highly stable chemical supplies, i‑TRANS Global will replicate Taiwan’s world‑leading chip‑chemical logistics expertise in Central Europe, simultaneously boosting demand for Taiwanese business interactions.

items.title: 〈星宇直飛布拉格〉細談三大洲航網規劃方向 這些航點均有機會直航
items.title_en: Starlux Direct Flights to Prague: Discussing the Planning Direction of Its Network Across Three Continents, These Destinations All Have Potential for Direct Service
paras: 星宇航空即將於10月25日首航台中-名古屋，在陸續深化日本航線布局後，認為近程航網大致完成，除了關注季節性的旅遊需求來放大機型因應，後續擴展航網主軸將著重在美洲、歐洲，同時大洋洲首個航點「快要有結果了」，包括雪梨、墨爾本、布里斯本等地都有機會。
星宇規劃，未來主要新航點將放在美國東部、中部和南部等，例如紐約、芝加哥、華盛頓等均在評估中，原因在於東南亞航線到美洲的旅客量能很大，善用台灣的轉機地理位置優勢。
同時，星宇也期待加強拓展歐洲，包括瑞士的蘇黎世、西班牙的巴塞隆納、芬蘭的赫爾辛基等，並發展在歐洲的合作夥伴，期待最快明年可看到歐洲新航點，但確定時程有待航權談判。
由於美洲沒有航權限制，擴張速度將較快。
星宇進一步提到，大洋洲擴點「快要有結果了」，包括雪梨、墨爾本、布里斯本等地都有機會。
星宇規劃，拓點會搭配交機時間，同步持續加大航班服務頻率，目前總機隊為38架，預估到年底可達42架，增加的4架新機分別為1架350-1000 、1架330-900 和2架321 Neo，明年再交機6架機隊，總數達48架。
paras_en: Starlux Airlines will launch its inaugural Taichung‑Nagoya flight on October 25. After progressively deepening its Japan route network, the airline believes its short‑haul network is largely complete. Apart from focusing on seasonal travel demand to upscale aircraft deployment, future network expansion will concentrate on the Americas and Europe, while the first Oceania destinations are "almost finalized," with Sydney, Melbourne and Brisbane also in contention.

Starlux plans to add new destinations mainly in the eastern, central and southern United States—cities such as New York, Chicago and Washington are under evaluation. The rationale is the large volume of passengers traveling from Southeast Asia to the Americas, allowing the airline to leverage Taiwan’s geographic advantage as a transfer hub.

The carrier also aims to strengthen its European footprint, targeting cities like Zurich in Switzerland, Barcelona in Spain and Helsinki in Finland, and to develop partnerships with European airlines. It hopes to see new European routes as early as next year, although exact timing depends on traffic‑rights negotiations.
Because there are no traffic‑rights restrictions for the Americas, expansion there is expected to proceed more quickly.
Starlux added that its Oceania expansion is "almost finalized," with Sydney, Melbourne and Brisbane all being possible new destinations.

Starlux’s expansion will be coordinated with aircraft deliveries and increased flight frequencies. The fleet currently stands at 38 aircraft and is projected to reach 42 by year‑end, adding one A350‑1000, one A330‑900 and two A321 Neo. An additional six aircraft are slated for delivery next year, bringing the total fleet to 48 planes.

items.title: 〈星宇直飛布拉格〉樂看Q4、明年上半年成長均達4成 惟憂心油價變數
items.title_en: StarLux Direct Flights to Prague: Optimistic About 40% Growth in Q4 and First Half of Next Year, but Worried About Oil Price Variable
paras: 進入第四季航空相對淡季，不過，星宇航空(2646-TW)公關長簡文龍明確指出，進入第四季後狀況還是不錯，訂位維持相對高，貨運也處在運輸旺季，「有望成長4成跑不掉」，而目前看明年訂位狀況，上半年還是有成長4成，惟油價是最大的不可控變數。
星宇說明，第四季東北亞線訂位狀況還是很好，滑雪旺季的旅遊需求熱絡，國人喜愛東京周邊越後湯澤、名古屋周邊飛馱高山和九州等地，而歐洲線因有耶誕節慶，表現也不差，整體航空基本面不錯。
不過，星宇直指主要面臨變數還是油價，且難以避開，「因應之道有限」。
星宇進一步說明，去年航空燃油平均每桶在80美元左右，4月以後最高達160-170 美元，導致用油成本從過往平均占總成本比重2成至目前來到約3成。
星宇今年前三季合併營收448.35億元，年增37%，10月起陸續開闢台北-峇里島、台中-札幌、台中-名古屋新航線，正持續擴大航網並深化旅遊市場布局，而隨著新機陸續交付，於冬季班表規劃多條熱門航線增班並放大機型。
其中，台北-函館和台北-清邁航線將安排增班並改以A330neo廣體客機執飛，顯示東北亞和東南亞的旅運需求持續居高。
paras_en: Entering the fourth quarter, which is relatively off‑peak for airlines, however, StarLux Airlines (2646‑TW) Chief Public Relations Officer Jian Wen‑long clearly stated that the situation after entering Q4 is still good, bookings remain relatively high, cargo is also in a peak season, "we expect a 40% growth that cannot be missed", and looking at next year's bookings, the first half also shows a 40% increase, but oil price is the biggest uncontrollable variable.

StarLux explained that the booking situation on Northeast Asia routes in Q4 remains very good; the ski season drives strong travel demand, with Taiwanese travelers favoring destinations such as Echigo‑Yuzawa near Tokyo, high‑altitude areas around Nagoya, and Kyushu, while European routes also performed well due to Christmas festivities, indicating an overall solid airline fundamentals.
However, StarLux pointed directly that the main variable remains oil price, and it is difficult to avoid, "the ways to cope are limited".

StarLux further noted that last year the average price of aviation fuel was around US$80 per barrel, and after April it peaked at US$160‑170, causing fuel costs to rise from about 20% of total costs historically to roughly 30% now.

StarLux’s combined revenue for the first three quarters of this year was NT$44.835 billion, up 37% year‑on‑year. Starting in October, the airline gradually opened new routes such as Taipei‑Bali, Taichung‑Sapporo, and Taichung‑Nagoya, continuously expanding its network and deepening its tourism market layout. With new aircraft being delivered, the winter schedule will add multiple popular routes and upscale aircraft types.

Among them, the Taipei‑Hakodate and Taipei‑Chiang Mai routes will add frequencies and will be operated with A330neo wide‑body jets, showing that travel demand in Northeast Asia and Southeast Asia remains high.

items.title_en: Focus Stock: Indium Phosphide Demand Booms, Guanghuan Rises Over Half, Above All Moving Averages
paras: 三五族光通訊廠受惠於全球AI資料中心軍備競賽，正從GPU、先進封裝一路燒向光通訊，光環(3234-TW)今(20)日開盤震盪，盤中在大單敲進下，量增價揚大漲7.5%，衝上193元，成交超過4,000張，較昨(19)日增近2倍。
光環因AI伺服器的算力愈來愈強，加上資料中心從800G向1.6T甚至3.2T演進，過去傳統銅線與電訊號逐漸遭遇傳輸距離、頻寬及功耗瓶頸。
光環以磷化銦(InP)磊晶為主的光通訊廠產品，也成為下一階段中，AI基礎建設的重要發展方向，包括光環間接打入Lumentum(LITE-US)、祥茂光電(AAOI-US)等美系光通訊大廠供應鏈。隨著 AI 資料中心傳輸規格由 800G 升級至 1.6T，對具備高發光效率、長距離傳輸特性的磷化銦 CW Laser(連續雷射)需求爆發，也帶動光環營收表現強勁增長
法人表示，以磷化銦(InP)磊晶為主的光通訊廠產品，也成為下一階段中，AI基礎建設的重要發展方向。
光環今(2026)年第3季營收 3.26 億元、季增66.3%，年增115.9%，成長動能來自於產品代工動能強勁，在毛利率上，考量到NRE收入與代工業務使稼動率持續提升，法人推估第3季毛利率有望提升至31.4%。
光環為因應客戶需求，也持續擴增磷化銦後段製程產能，法人估今(2026)年底產能有望較第3季翻倍成長，並同步採購設備已應付擴產。
據光環法說會上表示，光環企圖心也不只停留在現階段100mW產品，公司目前正積極打造300mW新產能，希望進一步切入CPO 供應鏈。法人表示，目前光還100mW CW Laser主要對應1.6T高速傳輸需求，當未來AI資料中心走向更高頻寬與CPO架構，高功率雷射的重要性將進一步提高。
paras_en: The optical communication factories of the 35mm family are benefiting from the global AI data‑center arms race, shifting from GPUs and advanced packaging to optical communications. Guanghuan (3234‑TW) opened today (20th) with a volatile start, but after a large order hit the market, volume surged and the price jumped 7.5% to NT$193, with more than 4,000 lots traded—almost double yesterday’s (19th) volume.

Because AI servers are becoming increasingly powerful and data centers are evolving from 800 Gbps to 1.6 Tbps and even 3.2 Tbps, traditional copper wiring and electrical signals are increasingly hitting limits in transmission distance, bandwidth, and power consumption.

Guanghuan’s optical‑communication products, which are based mainly on indium phosphide (InP) epitaxial wafers, have become a key development direction for the next stage of AI infrastructure. This includes indirect supply to major U.S. optical‑communication players such as Lumentum (LITE‑US) and AAOI (AAOI‑US). As AI data‑center transmission specs upgrade from 800 Gbps to 1.6 Tbps, demand for high‑efficiency, long‑distance InP continuous‑wave (CW) lasers is exploding, driving strong revenue growth for Guanghuan.
Institutions note that InP‑based optical‑communication products are becoming an important development direction for the next phase of AI infrastructure.

Guanghuan reported Q3 2026 revenue of NT$326 million, up 66.3% quarter‑over‑quarter and 115.9% year‑over‑year. The growth momentum comes from robust product foundry activity. Considering NRE income and foundry business that continuously raise utilization, analysts estimate the Q3 gross margin could rise to 31.4%.

To meet customer demand, Guanghuan is continuously expanding its downstream InP manufacturing capacity. Analysts estimate that by the end of 2026 the capacity could double compared with Q3, and the company is already procuring equipment to support the expansion.

At Guanghuan’s earnings briefing, the company said its ambition goes beyond the current 100 mW product line. It is actively building a new 300 mW production line to further enter the CPO supply chain. Analysts note that the current 100 mW InP CW lasers mainly serve the 1.6 Tbps high‑speed transmission market, and as AI data centers move toward higher bandwidth and CPO architectures, the importance of high‑power lasers will increase further.

items.title_en: Office Workers Reveal Their Most Valued Benefits! Survey Shows 98% Want Choose‑Your‑Own, 90% Prefer Cash‑Equivalents
paras: 灣產業面臨結構性缺工與高齡少子化雙重衝擊，薪資競爭力與實質福利已成為企業搶人、留才的關鍵籌碼。根據1111人力銀行今（20）日發布的「2026上班族最有感福利調查」，上班族的「最有感福利」，前三名聚焦實質經濟與休假保障，並有達98%上班族力挺公司改採「自選式」福利，若預算有限，更有90.8%受訪者希望直接將福利轉換為現金或獎金。
這項調查與1111人力銀行年度「幸福企業票選」相呼應，本屆吸引超過3422家企業參選，最終由637家獲獎金獎，數量創歷年新高，凸顯在人才戰場中，制度透明、實質補貼與彈性照顧已躍居企業永續營運的核心指標。
1111人力銀行總裁林文雄指出，2026年幸福企業評選延續嚴謹機制，並在ESG永續框架中特別強化S（Social）面向，配合政策表彰提供「生育獎勵與育兒支持」的優秀企業，聚焦產假、育兒津貼、彈性工時及親職友善等四大核心，期盼協助企業守護家庭並厚植人才韌性。調查顯示，若企業獲得「幸福企業」認證，有52.3%求職者表示會優先應徵，24.1%列入重要參考，足見雇主品牌已成招募利器。
但在員工實質感受上，福利往往與企業想像有落差。調查顯示，雖然有67.4%上班族對現有福利感到滿意，但也有32.6%表示不滿意；更有多達46.1%受訪者坦言「經常遇到」看得到卻用不到的福利。定義理想中的幸福企業，上班族最看重的條件前三名分別為「獎金及分紅制度透明」（65%）、「薪資具市場競爭力」（62.5%）與「工時合理且能準時下班」（57.8%）。
真正能打動人心的「最有感福利」，前三名清一色為實質經濟與休假保障，分別是「年終、績效或分紅獎金」（73.8%）、「三節獎金或禮品」（62%）及「額外特休或有薪假」（42.6%）。相對地，上班族最無感的福利則是「很少拿到的績效獎金」（53.4%）、「不合需求的三節禮品」（43.4%）與「強制或占用假日的員工旅遊」（34.1%）。
此外，原本意在凝聚向心力的職場活動，若缺乏自主選擇權，恐演變成員工無形負擔。調查發現，高達50.2%的上班族曾因不想參加員工旅遊、尾牙、聚餐或團體活動而感到壓力。1111人力銀行發言人曾仲葳表示，企業若未考量員工個別需求或缺乏實質價值，投入再多資源也難以轉換為滿意度。

針對福利運用，高達99.7%上班族認同良好的福利能提高應徵與留任意願。若企業預算有限，除了90.8%期望轉為薪資獎金外，也有57.1%希望增加休假或彈性工時、36.4%期待日常餐費交通補助。交叉分析更發現，希望「增加休假或彈性工時」者中，高達61.96%屬於需照顧長幼的「三明治族」。曾仲葳建議，企業應打破傳統僵化制度，透過彈性化與差異化的自選設計，才能在缺工時代精準回應員工需求，提升企業的核心留才競爭力。
paras_en: The Bay area’s industries face a dual blow from structural labor shortages and an aging, low‑birth‑rate population, making salary competitiveness and tangible benefits key tools for companies to attract and retain talent. According to the "2026 Office Workers Most Valued Benefits Survey" released today (20th) by 1111 Job Bank, the top three benefits that workers feel most strongly about focus on real economic gains and leave security, and 98% of employees support a "choose‑your‑own" benefits model. When budgets are tight, 90.8% of respondents prefer to convert benefits directly into cash or bonuses.

This survey aligns with 1111 Job Bank’s annual "Happy Company Voting". This year more than 3,422 companies entered, and a record 637 won monetary awards, highlighting that in the talent war, transparent policies, concrete subsidies and flexible care have become core indicators of sustainable corporate operation.

1111 Job Bank President Lin Wen‑xiong noted that the 2026 Happy Company selection continues its rigorous mechanism and strengthens the Social (S) pillar of the ESG framework, recognizing firms that provide "fertility incentives and childcare support". The focus is on four core areas: maternity leave, childcare allowances, flexible hours and family‑friendly policies, aiming to help companies protect families and build talent resilience. The survey shows that if a firm earns the "Happy Company" certification, 52.3% of job seekers would apply first and 24.1% would consider it an important factor, underscoring the power of employer branding in recruitment.

However, employees’ actual experiences often differ from corporate expectations. While 67.4% of office workers are satisfied with current benefits, 32.6% are not, and a striking 46.1% admit they frequently encounter benefits that are visible but unusable. When defining an ideal happy company, the top three criteria for workers are transparent bonus and profit‑sharing systems (65%), market‑competitive salaries (62.5%) and reasonable working hours with the ability to leave on time (57.8%).

The truly compelling "most felt" benefits are all concrete economic or leave guarantees: year‑end, performance or profit‑sharing bonuses (73.8%), holiday bonuses or gifts for the three major festivals (62%) and extra personal or paid leave (42.6%). Conversely, the least impactful benefits are rarely received performance bonuses (53.4%), festival gifts that don’t meet needs (43.4%) and mandatory or holiday‑occupying employee trips (34.1%).

Moreover, workplace activities intended to build cohesion can become an invisible burden if employees lack choice. The survey found that 50.2% of workers felt pressure when they didn’t want to join employee trips, year‑end parties, group meals or other gatherings. Spokesperson Zeng Zhong‑wei of 1111 Job Bank said that without considering individual needs or providing real value, even abundant resources cannot translate into satisfaction.

Regarding benefit usage, an overwhelming 99.7% of office workers agree that good benefits boost both application and retention willingness. When budgets are limited, besides the 90.8% who want conversion to salary bonuses, 57.1% hope for more leave or flexible hours, and 36.4% look for daily meal and transportation subsidies. Cross‑analysis reveals that among those desiring more leave or flexible hours, a high 61.96% are "sandwich generation" employees caring for both children and elders. Zeng recommends that companies break rigid traditional systems and adopt flexible, differentiated, choose‑your‑own designs to precisely meet employee needs in a labor‑shortage era and enhance core talent‑retention competitiveness.
